goal: Implement SMART outbound Kafka ingestion on the dedicated topic `aws.mulesoft.onemac.events` (dedicated Lambda + dedicated LATEST event source mapping, fully isolated from the CDC topic, changelog, and email processors) plus the first `operationType` handler `MSP_MANUAL_RECORD_CREATED`, which validates the envelope, transforms SMART payload names onto main-index field names, upserts a hidden SMART ID-reservation document that blocks OneMAC package-ID reuse, and logs collisions to a dedicated CloudWatch log stream without mutating the existing document (OY2-40481 + OY2-41233 slice).

tasks.title: Explorer: resolve remaining U1/U8 repo evidence for reservation status and state derivation
acceptance_criteria: Reports the exact file path, exported symbol name, and line number of the SEATOOL_STATUS constant collection and of `isActiveMainNonDraftPackage` in `lib/packages/shared-types/**` and `lib/libs/**`/`lib/lambda/**`.

Enumerates every seatoolStatus value that makes `isActiveMainNonDraftPackage` return true, and names the 1-3 candidate values usable for a SMART ID reservation, each with a stated downside (U1 stays flagged as open; explorer recommends, does not decide).
Reports the existing repo pattern (file + symbol) that derives a 2-letter `state` from a package `id`, so the transform can reuse it rather than invent one (U8).
Reports how `itemExists` and `checkIdentifierUsage` query the main index (index name resolution, `_id` vs `id`, deleted filter) with file:line citations.
Reports the existing test harness pattern used by Kafka sink tests (mock style for opensearch client and for base64 Kafka records) with at least one concrete example test file path.
Produces no file mutations in the repo (read-only run).
Explicitly restates U1, U2, U3, U8, and U11 as still-open and does not assert a final answer for any of them.

tasks.title: TDD red: envelope validation, base64 decode, and operationType dispatch tests
acceptance_criteria: Creates `lib/lambda/sinkSmart.test.ts` beside the (not yet existing) handler; does not add SMART cases to `lib/lambda/sinkMain.test.ts` or reuse CDC fixtures.
Test: Kafka record `key` and `value` supplied base64-encoded are decoded before JSON parse; a record whose value is raw (non-base64) JSON does not crash the consumer.
Test: message key string must equal `payload.id`; a mismatch is logged and skipped, and no index write is attempted.

Test: missing any required envelope field (`spaWaiverId`, `id`, `correlationId`, `origin`, `authority`, `status`, `createdAt`, `createdByUserId`, `createdByName`, `createdByEmail`) is a validation failure that is logged and skipped, not thrown.
Test: `origin` casing is strict — `"smart"`, `"Smart"`, and a `source` key instead of `origin` each fail validation and are not silently normalized to `"SMART"`.
Test: extra unknown properties (`creationContext`, `state`, `initialSubmissionDate`, and an arbitrary `zzzUnknown` key) survive parsing and remain readable on the parsed object.

Test: `operationType` values other than `MSP_MANUAL_RECORD_CREATED` (including `MSP_STATUS_UPDATED` and a fabricated `NOT_A_REAL_TYPE`) are logged and skipped, and the handler resolves successfully without throwing.
Test: a batch containing one invalid and one valid record processes the valid record and does not fail the whole batch.
Test asserts the SMART module graph does not import `processEmails`, `sinkChangelog`, or `insertOneMacRecordsFromKafkaIntoMako`.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/sinkSmart.test.ts` fails (red) for missing-implementation reasons only, not for syntax or import-resolution errors in the test file itself.

tasks.title: Implement SMART consumer entrypoint: base64 decode, envelope schema, operationType dispatcher
acceptance_criteria: Adds `lib/lambda/sinkSmart.ts` exporting a Kafka handler, with shared validation/dispatch helpers under `lib/lambda/smart/`.
Decodes Kafka `key` and `value` from base64 before JSON parse.
Validates the envelope with a schema requiring `origin` to equal the exact literal `"SMART"` (no case normalization) and requiring key === `payload.id`.
Unknown/unhandled `operationType` is validated, logged, and skipped; the handler never throws for unknown types (unlike `sinkMain` unknown-topic behavior).
Extra payload properties are retained on the parsed object (schema is non-stripping / passthrough).
Imports nothing from `processEmails`, `sinkChangelog`, `sinkMainProcessors`, or `insertOneMacRecordsFromKafkaIntoMako`.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/sinkSmart.test.ts` passes with zero failing tests.
`bun run lint` exits 0 and `bun run test-tsc` exits 0.

tasks.title: TDD red: MSP_MANUAL_RECORD_CREATED transform tests (SMART payload to main-index field names)
acceptance_criteria: Creates `lib/lambda/smart/mspManualRecordCreated.test.ts` using the exact Confluence example payload from the spec as the happy-path fixture.
Test: transformed document sets `id` (normalized per existing repo convention), `origin: "SMART"`, `authority` from payload, and `deleted: false`.
Test: `seatoolStatus` is set to the constant chosen in T1 and that value satisfies `isActiveMainNonDraftPackage` (asserted by calling the real helper, not a hardcoded string comparison).

Test: `state` is the 2-letter code derived from `id` (`"AL"` for `AL-26-0817-0001`), not the SMART full state name `"Alabama"`; the SMART `state` value is retained on the document under a non-conflicting key.
Test: `createdAt` maps to the ISO date fields named in the spec field map (`submissionDate`, `makoChangedDate`, `changedDate`, `statusDate`) and `proposedDate` is left unset.
Test: `createdByName` maps to `submitterName`, `createdByEmail` maps to `submitterEmail`.
Test: `spaWaiverId`, `correlationId`, `operationType`, `creationContext`, and `createdByUserId` are all present on the transformed document.
Test: the transform is pure — it performs no OpenSearch call and no CloudWatch call.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/smart/mspManualRecordCreated.test.ts` fails (red) for missing-implementation reasons only.

tasks.title: Implement MSP_MANUAL_RECORD_CREATED transform onto main-index field names
acceptance_criteria: Adds `lib/lambda/smart/mspManualRecordCreated.ts` exporting a pure transform from validated SMART event to main-index document.
Implements exactly the spec field map; introduces no mapping not listed in the spec's candidate field-map table.
Sets the T1-selected non-draft `seatoolStatus` and leaves an inline comment marking U1 as an open decision to confirm before deploy.
Derives `state` from `id` using the existing repo helper identified in T1 rather than a new local parser.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/smart/mspManualRecordCreated.test.ts` passes with zero failing tests.
`bun run lint` exits 0 and `bun run test-tsc` exits 0.

tasks.title: TDD red: reservation write and collision-log tests (exists-by-id, no overwrite)
acceptance_criteria: Creates `lib/lambda/smart/reservePackageId.test.ts` beside the writer with mocked OpenSearch and mocked `@aws-sdk/client-cloudwatch-logs`.
Test: when no main-index document exists for `id`, exactly one write is issued for `_id === payload.id` and zero CloudWatch calls are made.
Test: when a main-index document already exists for `id` (any `origin`, including `OneMAC` and `SEATool`), zero OpenSearch write/update/bulk calls are issued.
Test: on collision, `CreateLogStream` is called before `PutLogEvents` (ordering asserted), and a `ResourceAlreadyExistsException` from `CreateLogStream` is swallowed so `PutLogEvents` still runs.
Test: the collision log event body contains `id`, `spaWaiverId`, `correlationId`, `operationType`, the existing document's `origin`, and the incoming payload, and contains no credential-like values.
Test: the collision log targets the group and stream names from the U3 proposal, read from configuration/env rather than hardcoded inline in the writer call site.
Test: a CloudWatch failure is logged and does not throw out of the handler (no consumer poisoning).
`./run test --run lib/lambda/smart/reservePackageId.test.ts` fails (red) for missing-implementation reasons only.

tasks.title: Implement ID-reservation writer plus CloudWatch collision logger
acceptance_criteria: Adds `lib/lambda/smart/reservePackageId.ts` performing exists/get by `id` against the main index before any write.
On miss, indexes the reservation document keyed by `_id = id`; on hit, performs no document mutation of any kind (no `doc_as_upsert`, no partial update, no bulk).
Adds `@aws-sdk/client-cloudwatch-logs` as a dependency and a thin collision-logger module that calls `CreateLogStream` (idempotent, tolerating already-exists) then `PutLogEvents`.

Log group and stream names come from environment variables wired by CDK, defaulting to the U3 proposal (`/aws/mako/${stage}/smart-onemac-collisions`, stream `msp-manual-record-created`), with an inline comment marking U3 as proposed and unconfirmed.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/smart/reservePackageId.test.ts` passes with zero failing tests.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/sinkSmart.test.ts` still passes (no regression in the dispatcher).
`bun run lint` exits 0 and `bun run test-tsc` exits 0.

tasks.title: Regression tests: SMART reservation blocks OneMAC ID reuse and stays hidden from lists
acceptance_criteria: Adds cases to `lib/lambda/itemExists.test.ts` and `lib/lambda/checkIdentifierUsage.test.ts` (or new sibling test files) using a SMART reservation document produced by the T5 transform as the fixture.

Test: `checkIdentifierUsage` blocks the same `id` for a SMART reservation document.
Test in `lib/lambda/search.test.ts` (or sibling): a SMART-origin document is excluded from package-list results by the existing `origin.keyword` allowlist, with no new hide flag introduced.

All added tests pass against the current implementation without modifying `itemExists.ts`, `checkIdentifierUsage.ts`, or `search.ts`; if any fails, the failure is reported as a U1 status-selection defect rather than patched by loosening the test.
`./run test --run lib/lambda/itemExists.test.ts`, `./run test --run lib/lambda/checkIdentifierUsage.test.ts`, and `./run test --run lib/lambda/search.test.ts` all pass.

Test: no event source mapping attaches the SMART Lambda to `aws.onemac.migration.cdc`, and no existing CDC/changelog/email mapping is repointed at `aws.mulesoft.onemac.events`.

tasks.title: Wire CDK: dedicated SMART topic, Lambda, standalone LATEST event source mapping, collision log group and IAM
acceptance_criteria: Adds the SMART Lambda and a standalone `CfnEventSourceMapping` with `startingPosition: "LATEST"` in `lib/stacks/data.ts`, following the email-stack pattern rather than routing through reindex `createTriggers` (U11 recommendation).

tasks.title: Register SMART Lambda in exports and Splunk source map; document offset-reset runbook
acceptance_criteria: `lib/lambda/index.ts` exports the SMART handler so the stack can bundle it.
`.github/skills/splunk/references/source-mapping.md` contains an entry for the new SMART Lambda matching the format of existing entries.

A short offset-reset runbook note exists in the repo describing: delete the SMART event source mapping, recreate it with a NEW consumer group ID, and choose `LATEST` normally or `TRIM_HORIZON`/`AT_TIMESTAMP` only when deliberately replaying; the note states that reusing the same consumer group does not reset offsets.
The runbook note explicitly records U3 (log group/stream naming) and U1 (reservation seatoolStatus) as unconfirmed items to verify before production rollout.
`bun run lint` exits 0, `bun run test-tsc` exits 0, and the full `./run test --run lib/lambda` suite passes.
No secrets, credentials, or account IDs appear in the added documentation.

routing.reason: Scoped handler; medium risk, not high.
PlanPacket risk=high (OpenSearch write + CloudWatch Logs SDK). Roster frontier slug claude-opus-4-8-thinking-xhigh unavailable; using latest available Claude thinking.
CDK test authoring; parallel after T7.
PlanPacket risk=high (Kafka ESM, IAM, topic create). Roster frontier slug unavailable; using latest available Claude thinking.
Exports, Splunk map, runbook. Standard implementer is enough.

assumptions: U1 UNRESOLVED: the specific SEATOOL_STATUS constant used for the SMART reservation is chosen by explorer evidence in T1 and asserted behaviorally in T8 (must satisfy isActiveMainNonDraftPackage), but the product-correct value is not confirmed. Implementation must mark it with an inline open-question comment and it must be confirmed before deploy.

U2 UNRESOLVED (planner recommendation only): T9/T10 add SMART exclusion to package detail (item.ts). Lists are already hidden by the existing search.ts origin allowlist; detail hiding is a recommendation, not a locked product decision.

U3 UNRESOLVED: collision log group `/aws/mako/${stage}/smart-onemac-collisions` and stream `msp-manual-record-created` are the spec proposal only. Names are env-var driven so they can change without code edits; retention is not specified and must be confirmed with ops.
U8 UNRESOLVED (proposal): `state` is derived from `id` using the existing repo transform pattern rather than the SMART full state name, and the SMART `state` value is retained as an extra property.

U11 UNRESOLVED (planner recommendation): use an email-style standalone CfnEventSourceMapping at LATEST and keep the SMART topic out of the reindex createTriggers path, so data-reindex cannot recreate the mapping as TRIM_HORIZON. If the team prefers createTriggers, T11/T12 must be replanned.
U5/U10 per spec: unknown operationType payloads are logged and skipped this slice; no second index, no persistence. Recovery is Kafka replay via operator offset reset.
U7 partial: `createdAt` drives the ISO date fields and `proposedDate` is left unset because this event carries no proposed date.
U9 proposal: `spaWaiverId` is stored as a main-index field pending OY2-39746, which is not in the repo and may later rename it.
Handler naming is `lib/lambda/sinkSmart.ts` with helpers under `lib/lambda/smart/`; if the team prefers `sinkMulesoftOnemac`, rename consistently across T3, T12, and T13.

OpenSearch preflight exists-then-write is race-prone; this slice accepts the race because SMART is a low-volume single-producer stream. Atomic `op_type=create` is a hardening follow-up, not this slice.
Repo gates are `./run test --run <path>`, `bun run lint`, and `bun run test-tsc`. No new gates are invented. `bun.lockb` should not be staged if a verifier `./run install` dirties it.
Branch token is stage-safe lowercase (`oy2-40481-smart-outbound-events`); the pre-push hook runs eslint plus detect-secrets, so budget time in the ship phase.
out_of_scope: Full handlers for MSP_STATUS_UPDATED, MSP_SPLIT_SPA_CREATED, MSP_RAI_WITHDRAWAL_TOGGLED, and MSP_ASSIGNMENT_UPDATED (OY2-41234 through OY2-41237) — these stay stubbed as log-and-skip.
Any change to SMART or MuleSoft producers.
Showing SMART-only records in any OneMAC list or detail workflow as a new submission.
Sending emails or running migration-CDC business logic for SMART events; no changes to processEmails, sinkChangelog, insertOneMacRecordsFromKafkaIntoMako, or the CDC/email event source mappings.
Merging SMART fields onto an existing OneMAC package on collision (superseded older OY2-40481 note; deferred).
Completing the OY2-39746 external-ID schema work beyond retaining spaWaiverId on the indexed document.
Persisting unknown operationType payloads to any index or dead-letter store.
Deploying, running cdk deploy, resetting real Kafka offsets, or creating real AWS log groups.
Commits, pushes, PRs, review, or ship in this planning run.
